description: Search ImportYeti by name, product, address, HS code, location or product tag and optionally open profiles for trading partners, recent bills of lading, HS/HTS codes, lanes, carriers and UFLPA flags.

entityType.description: Keep only US importers (companies), only overseas suppliers, or both. Search uses ImportYeti's own server-side type filter; HS, location and tag modes filter their supplier/company tables.
entityType.sectionDescription: Optional filters for the entities returned. ImportYeti does not apply recency or minimum shipments on its search endpoint, so those filters run locally over the reachable rows.
entityType.title: Entity type

hsCodes.description: 2-, 4- or 6-digit HS codes, e.g. 85, 8471, 8507.60, or full /hs-codes/... URLs (mode=byHsCodes). Each code returns its top suppliers, top US companies and recent shipments.
hsCodes.title: HS codes

includeProfileDetails.description: Open each matched company or supplier and return its trading partners, recent bills of lading and trade details. Adds one request per profile. Applies to search and URL modes; HS, location and tag pages already contain their tables.
includeProfileDetails.sectionDescription: These controls only change what is included when profiles are opened. The daily test keeps them off for the smallest possible run.
includeProfileDetails.title: Open profiles for details

includeTradeDetails.description: Emit HS/HTS codes, port lanes, carriers, containers, notify parties, other addresses, tags and monthly history from the opened profile. Only applies when profile details are opened.
includeTradeDetails.title: Include trade details

locationType.description: Whether bare country slugs point at the overseas-supplier directory or the US-importer directory. Ignored for full location URLs.
locationType.title: Bare location type

locations.description: Country slugs such as china or vietnam, or full /location/... URLs for states, counties and cities (mode=byLocations). Bare slugs use the location type below.
locations.title: Locations

maxPartners.description: Cap the top-supplier or top-customer table per profile. ImportYeti exposes up to 50.
maxPartners.title: Max partners per profile

maxResults.description: Maximum records to return in this run. ImportYeti caps a search query at 280 reachable rows (140 per entity type); use more search queries for more. Every profile exposes at most 50 partners and 50 recent shipments.
maxResults.title: Max results

maxShipments.description: Cap the recent bill-of-lading rows per profile. ImportYeti exposes up to 50.
maxShipments.title: Max recent shipments per profile

minShipments.description: Drop entities with fewer than this many lifetime shipments. Applied locally.
minShipments.title: Minimum shipments

mode.description: What to scrape. Search matches names, product keywords and address text. URL, HS-code, location and product-tag modes read the corresponding ImportYeti pages directly.
enumTitles: Search by name, product, or address
Find importers & suppliers by HS code
Browse a country, state, or city
mode.title: Mode

productTags.description: Product-tag slugs such as yoga-mat or lithium-battery, or full /tags/... URLs (mode=byProductTags).
productTags.title: Product tags

searchQueries.description: Company names, brands, product keywords, or address text (mode=search). One entry per search. ImportYeti searches names, indexed product text and address text; a trademark name works as a brand search, not a separate trademark index.
searchQueries.sectionDescription: Choose the input that matches the selected mode. Only the field for the active mode is used; the others can stay empty.
searchQueries.title: Search queries

shipmentRecency.description: Keep only entities with a shipment in this window. ImportYeti's search API ignores this filter, so it is applied locally to the dates the source returns.
shipmentRecency.title: Most recent shipment within

startUrls.description: Company, supplier, HS-code, location, product-tag or search URLs (mode=byUrls). Full https://www.importyeti.com/... links or paths such as company/apple are accepted.

url.description: Full ImportYeti URL or path, e.g. https://www.importyeti.com/company/apple.
url.title: URL

startUrls.title: ImportYeti URLs

title: ImportYeti Importer & Supplier Trade Explorer
